prediction_ref.short_label: Transformer-only inference ASICs gain a first-class serving-stack backend by H1 2027

validation_rows.evidence_summary: Etched July 1 stealth exit is the origin evidence: a transformer-specialized inference ASIC on TSMC N4P with a working chip in hand, more than $1 billion in customer contracts signed before shipment, and an architecture that hard-wires the transformer and shares one low-latency memory pool across the scale-up domain over a proprietary interconnect. The load-bearing point for this prediction is the demand signal, not the funding: a fixed-function part only pays off if production model traffic can reach it without a bespoke per-deployment integration, and today the mainstream serving runtimes assume a programmable GPU underneath with paged-attention and continuous-batching schedulers. A pre-ship order book measured in billions is exactly the pull that turns backend generality from the ASIC vendor private problem into a feature the serving layer must ship. Etched itself does not yet expose a mainstream serving-stack backend, so this is an origin pulse establishing the coupling rather than a landing.

prediction_ref.short_label: Companion-agent memory guardrails become binding rules in a second major market by Q4 2027

validation_rows.evidence_summary: China Interim Measures for the Administration of AI Anthropomorphic Interaction Services, issued April 2026 and effective July 15, are the origin evidence: the first live regime treating persistent-identity emotional-companion agents as a regulated product surface. ByteDance Doubao and Alibaba Qwen resolved compliance over the July 3-6 weekend by switching features off rather than redesigning, with Qwen disabling humanlike and user-created agents July 10 and broader agent services July 15, and Doubao pulling its agent feature July 15 while giving users until October 15 to export data. The load-bearing detail is the mandate shape, not the shutdown: anti-addiction systems, in-session usage notifications, and instant-exit mechanisms, with a carve-out for customer-service, knowledge-Q&A, workplace, and education tools lacking the companion framing. That draws a precise, copyable line around long-horizon memory and a consistent cross-session persona. The prediction requires a second jurisdiction to convert overlapping consumer-protection pressure into a binding instrument tracking the same scope, which today does not yet show.
